Alexandra Chen stands out as a rare blend of technical mastery and operational leadership, exemplified by her role as Senior Site Reliability Engineer at AdVelox Media. Her ability to architect resilient systems on AWS, where she redesigned global infrastructure to reduce latency by 30% while scaling to 15M+ daily requests, underscores her strategic mindset. She consistently integrates ArgoCD into CI/CD workflows, enabling zero-downtime deployments that have maintained 99.99% uptime across adtech platforms.  

Her incident management expertise shines through measurable outcomes: during a critical outage, she orchestrated a 4-hour resolution by isolating faulty microservices, preventing $200K in revenue loss. This incident solidified her ownership of SLA/SLO governance, refining metrics that improved system reliability by 25% over 18 months. Alexandra’s Python-driven automation tools for monitoring and alerting via Prometheus/Grafana have streamlined incident response, reducing mean time to resolution by 40%.  

Beyond technical rigor, her collaborative spirit and attention to detail foster team excellence. She thrives under pressure, balancing innovation with stability—a testament to her dedication. Alexandra’s work at AdVelox has not only elevated engineering standards but also positioned the company as a industry leader in adtech scalability. I wholeheartedly recommend her for any opportunity requiring both technical depth and leadership acumen.
